metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.
metric_policy.storage_note: Unpacked behavioral memory arrays are reported as memory_bit_count, not flipflop_count.

registers.name: CONTROL_0
registers.description: Primary control byte. Writing the enable/launch/clear bits affects request issuance and fault handling. Soft reset is level-sensitive within the synchronous control plane and should be pulsed by firmware.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable for request issuance and closed-loop operation.

fields.name: SOFT_RESET
fields.description: Requests a synchronous soft-reset action in the control plane.

fields.name: LAUNCH
fields.description: Launches one outbound surrogate request when ENABLE is set and outstanding limit allows it. Self-clearing after acceptance behavior is implementation-defined but the request must be issued once per asserted launch event.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR
fields.description: Clears transient fault latches according to sticky-fault policy.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT
fields.description: Retains fault latches until firmware explicitly clears them.

fields.name: PIPELINED_MODE
fields.description: Allows limited multiple outstanding requests when supported by the outstanding limit.

fields.name: SESSION_ROLLOVER
fields.description: Indicates host-managed session rollover; stale detection uses this to invalidate older request context.

fields.name: STATUS_CLEAR
fields.description: Clears latched IRQ/status indications without changing unrelated control state.

registers.name: REQUEST_0
registers.description: Request metadata byte 0. Encodes request type and sequence seed low bits.

fields.name: REQUEST_TYPE
fields.description: 8-bit request type tag placed into the outbound surrogate request word.

registers.name: REQUEST_1
registers.description: Request metadata byte 1. Sequence seed high byte.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_SEED_LSB
fields.description: Low byte of the 16-bit sequence seed used as the initial request sequence basis.

registers.name: REQUEST_2
registers.description: Request metadata byte 2. Sequence seed high byte and compact model identifiers low bits.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_SEED_MSB
fields.description: High byte of the 16-bit sequence seed.

registers.name: REQUEST_3
registers.description: Request metadata byte 3. Operating velocity low byte.

fields.name: OPERATING_VELOCITY_LSB
fields.description: Low byte of the 16-bit representative operating velocity in the supported envelope, e.g. 38.89 m/s encoded by firmware convention.

registers.name: REQUEST_4
registers.description: Request metadata byte 4. Operating velocity high byte.

fields.name: OPERATING_VELOCITY_MSB
fields.description: High byte of the 16-bit operating velocity field.

registers.name: REQUEST_5
registers.description: Request metadata byte 5. Velocity fraction low byte.

fields.name: VELOCITY_FRACTION_LSB
fields.description: Low byte of the 16-bit velocity fraction field used as compact operating-point metadata.

registers.name: REQUEST_6
registers.description: Request metadata byte 6. Velocity fraction high byte.

fields.name: VELOCITY_FRACTION_MSB
fields.description: High byte of the 16-bit velocity fraction field.

registers.name: REQUEST_7
registers.description: Request metadata byte 7. Reference ID low byte.

fields.name: REFERENCE_ID_LSB
fields.description: Low byte of the 16-bit compact reference identifier for DrivAerML or equivalent host-side reference naming.

registers.name: REQUEST_8
registers.description: Request metadata byte 8. Reference ID high byte.

fields.name: REFERENCE_ID_MSB
fields.description: High byte of the 16-bit compact reference identifier.

registers.name: REQUEST_9
registers.description: Request metadata byte 9. Geometry ID low byte.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_ID_LSB
fields.description: Low byte of the compact geometry identifier. No raw geometry payload is stored in RTL.

registers.name: REQUEST_10
registers.description: Request metadata byte 10. Geometry ID high byte.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_ID_MSB
fields.description: High byte of the compact geometry identifier.
